mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_nm, m.upper_menu_id, m.menu_level, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.menu_icon, m.use_yn FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_author rma ON m.menu_id = rma.menu_id WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND rma.role_cd = #{roleCd} AND rma.read_author_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.menu_level, m.menu_order

SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_nm, m.upper_menu_id, m.menu_level, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.menu_icon, m.use_yn FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_user_menu_author uma ON m.menu_id = uma.menu_id WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND uma.user_id = #{userId} AND uma.read_author_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.menu_level, m.menu_order

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.menu_nm, m.upper_menu_id, m.menu_level, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.menu_icon, m.use_yn FROM (
SELECT m.menu_id FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_author rma ON m.menu_id = rma.menu_id WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND rma.role_cd = #{roleCd} AND rma.read_author_yn = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT m.menu_id FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_user_menu_author uma ON m.menu_id = uma.menu_id WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND uma.user_id = #{userId} AND uma.read_author_yn = 'Y'
) AS combined INNER JOIN tb_menu m ON combined.menu_id = m.menu_id ORDER BY m.menu_level, m.menu_order

SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_nm, m.upper_menu_id, (SELECT menu_nm FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_id = m.upper_menu_id) AS upper_menu_nm, m.menu_level, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.menu_icon, m.use_yn, TO_CHAR(m.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regist_dt FROM tb_menu m WHERE 1=1
AND m.menu_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY m.menu_level, m.menu_order

SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_nm, m.upper_menu_id, (SELECT menu_nm FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_id = m.upper_menu_id) AS upper_menu_nm, m.menu_level, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.menu_icon, m.use_yn, m.register_id, TO_CHAR(m.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regist_dt, m.updusr_id, TO_CHAR(m.updt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updt_dt FROM tb_menu m WHERE m.menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menu ( menu_id, menu_nm, upper_menu_id, menu_level, menu_order, menu_url, menu_icon, use_yn, register_id, regist_dt ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{menuNm}, #{upperMenuId}, CAST(#{menuLevel} AS INTEGER), COALESCE(CAST(#{menuOrder} AS INTEGER), 0), #{menuUrl}, #{menuIcon}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{registerId}, NOW() )
mapper.update:
UPDATE tb_menu SET menu_nm = #{menuNm},
upper_menu_id = #{upperMenuId},
upper_menu_id = NULL,
menu_level = CAST(#{menuLevel} AS INTEGER), menu_order = COALESCE(CAST(#{menuOrder} AS INTEGER), 0), menu_url = #{menuUrl}, menu_icon = #{menuIcon}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updusr_id = #{updusrId}, updt_dt = NOW() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_cd, r.role_nm, COALESCE(rma.role_menu_author_sn, 0) AS role_menu_author_sn, COALESCE(rma.read_author_yn, 'N') AS read_author_yn, COALESCE(rma.creat_author_yn, 'N') AS creat_author_yn, COALESCE(rma.updt_author_yn, 'N') AS updt_author_yn, COALESCE(rma.delete_author_yn, 'N') AS delete_author_yn FROM tb_role r LEFT JOIN tb_role_menu_author rma ON r.role_cd = rma.role_cd AND rma.menu_id = #{menuId} WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY r.role_cd

SELECT ur.user_role_sn, u.user_id, u.user_nm, ur.role_cd, r.role_nm, ur.register_id, TO_CHAR(ur.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regist_dt FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_user u ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN tb_role r ON ur.role_cd = r.role_cd WHERE ur.role_cd = #{roleCd} AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY u.user_nm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_role_menu_author ( role_cd, menu_id, read_author_yn, creat_author_yn, updt_author_yn, delete_author_yn, register_id, regist_dt ) VALUES ( #{roleCd}, #{menuId}, COALESCE(#{readAuthorYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{creatAuthorYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{updtAuthorYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{deleteAuthorYn}, 'N'), #{registerId}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_role_menu DO UPDATE SET read_author_yn = COALESCE(#{readAuthorYn}, 'N'), creat_author_yn = COALESCE(#{creatAuthorYn}, 'N'), updt_author_yn = COALESCE(#{updtAuthorYn}, 'N'), delete_author_yn = COALESCE(#{deleteAuthorYn}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT uma.user_menu_author_sn, uma.user_id, u.user_nm, uma.menu_id, uma.read_author_yn, uma.creat_author_yn, uma.updt_author_yn, COALESCE(uma.delete_author_yn, 'N') AS delete_author_yn, uma.register_id, TO_CHAR(uma.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regist_dt, uma.updusr_id, TO_CHAR(uma.updt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updt_dt FROM tb_user_menu_author uma JOIN tb_user u ON uma.user_id = u.user_id WHERE uma.menu_id = #{menuId} AND u.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY u.user_nm

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm, #{menuId} AS menu_id, COALESCE(uma.read_author_yn, 'N') AS read_author_yn, COALESCE(uma.creat_author_yn, 'N') AS creat_author_yn, COALESCE(uma.updt_author_yn, 'N') AS updt_author_yn, COALESCE(uma.delete_author_yn, 'N') AS delete_author_yn, uma.user_menu_author_sn FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_user_menu_author uma ON u.user_id = uma.user_id AND uma.menu_id = #{menuId} WHERE u.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY u.user_nm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_menu_author ( user_id, menu_id, read_author_yn, creat_author_yn, updt_author_yn, delete_author_yn, register_id, regist_dt ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{menuId}, COALESCE(#{readAuthorYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{creatAuthorYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{updtAuthorYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{deleteAuthorYn}, 'N'), #{registerId}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_user_menu DO UPDATE SET read_author_yn = COALESCE(#{readAuthorYn}, 'N'), creat_author_yn = COALESCE(#{creatAuthorYn}, 'N'), updt_author_yn = COALESCE(#{updtAuthorYn}, 'N'), delete_author_yn = COALESCE(#{deleteAuthorYn}, 'N'), updusr_id = #{registerId}, updt_dt = NOW()
